diff.golden:
1. Cut 200g chicken breast into 1 cm cubes; marinate with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 0.5 tsp cornstarch for 15 minutes.
2. Toast peanuts in a dry pan over low heat until golden; cut dried chilies into ~1 cm sections.
3. Make sauce: mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, 0.5 tsp cornstarch.
4. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok; stir-fry dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant.
5. Add chicken; stir-fry over high heat ~2 minutes until cooked through.
6. Pour in sauce and toss until thickened.
7. Add peanuts and scallions; stir briefly and serve.
